intro: Each platform uses product photos and short videos in different places. Browse the full list for channel-specific sizes, examples, and tips, then download the file and upload it where you sell.

faq.q: Can one vertical video work on TikTok, Reels and Shorts?
faq.a: Yes, a 9:16 file fits all three. Each app places its buttons and captions a little differently, so look at the clip in each one before you spend money behind it.

faq.q: Do you post the finished ads to my accounts?
faq.a: No. You download the video or photo and upload it yourself, whether that's in an ad account, your Shopify admin or your Amazon listing.

faq.q: Which ad format should I make first for my store?
faq.a: Start with the placement where you already buy traffic: 9:16 for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts; 1:1 for feeds; 16:9 for wide placements.

faq.q: Can I reuse one product creative on every platform?
faq.a: Choose a ratio for each separate generation; one run makes one video. Add captions, sound, and on-screen text in the platform editor.
